title: Mattermost Plugins versions <=12.-1 11.0.11 11.11.7 11.2.10.0 fail to verify that the caller can post in a run's…
description: Mattermost Plugins versions <=12.-1 11.0.11 11.11.7 11.2.10.0 fail to verify that the caller can post in a run's channel when executing a checklist slash command which allows an authenticated run participant to post arbitrary messages into a private channel they are not a member of via the checklist item run endpoint. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00730
